seams.title: Add enlist
seams.clause: Enlist (As this creature attacks, you may tap a nonattacking creature you control without summoning sickness. When you do, add its power to this creature's until end of turn.) / Whenever this creature enlists a creature, scry 2.
seams.why: CR 702.154: an optional cost to attack (CR 508.1g) paid by tapping another untapped creature that was not declared as an attacker and has haste or has been under your control since the turn began, plus a linked trigger giving +X/+0. Nothing in internal/game offers a per-attacker optional tap of ANOTHER creature at declaration. Expect to extend game/attackers.go beside the exert choice (attackers.go:105-121, game/exert.go, ADR 0130), the declare-attackers protocol/client prompt (which creature is enlisted), the legal probe, the bot's declaration, and an 'enlisted' event for Guardian of New Benalia's trigger. An enlisted creature cannot also be an attacker, and one creature cannot be tapped for two enlists.
seams.checked: grep -rli enlist server/internal/game -> none; cards/effects -> cenns_enlistment.go (card name only), retrace_followups_test.go. grep 'enlists a creature' -> 0. grep 'OptionalAttackCost|AttackCostChoice|508.1g' in game -> only exert files (attackers.go, exert.go, declaration_control.go, card.go, mutations.go), which tap/exert the attacker itself.

seams.title: Let a permanent offer '2 life' on coloured permanent spells, with the linked coloured discount
seams.clause: As an additional cost to cast blue permanent spells, you may pay 2 life. Those spells cost {U} less to cast if you paid life this way. This effect reduces only the amount of blue mana you pay.
seams.why: The grant half has a seam: game/granted_optional_cost.go (GrantedOptionalCost, Silverquill the Disputant). Missing: a cost reduction that applies only when that granted cost was announced. CostQuery.OptionalCosts (game/cost_modifier.go) carries the printed indices; granted costs are recorded by key on PaidCost.GrantedOptional and no cost modifier reads them. Also to confirm: a granted cost priced in life, a reduction that takes only a coloured symbol (CostModifier.Unit), one offer per Defiler on the battlefield (EachSource), and that Karn's Sylex (s3) switches the offer off. Start from granted_optional_cost.go and cost_modifier.go; if the reduction can already see the announcement, this is five ordinary cards.
seams.checked: grep 'As an additional cost to cast .* spells, you may pay' -> 0; 'reduces only the amount of' -> 0; 'you may pay 2 life' -> 9 files, none a grant to other spells; life_for_mana.go (K'rrik) replaces a mana symbol with life, which is a different rule. grep GrantedOptionalCost in cards/effects -> casualty.go, conspire.go, silverquill_the_disputant.go, raiding_schemes.go, hugh_first_of_many.go.

seams.title: Add 'players can't pay life to cast spells or activate non-mana abilities'
seams.clause: Players can't pay life to cast spells or to activate abilities that aren't mana abilities.
seams.why: No restriction of this kind exists. Paying life is gated only by 'can't lose life' (game/effect_api.go PayLifeForEffect, payLifeAsCostLocked in life_tail.go). Needs a world rule in game/restrictions.go read by spell and ability cost payment (printed life costs, Phyrexian mana, K'rrik's life-for-mana, granted costs such as s2), by the legal offers and by the client's payment choices; mana abilities stay exempt. The rest of the card (enters tapped; {X},{T}, exile: destroy each nonland permanent with mana value X or less, sorcery speed, declares Sweep) is ordinary.
seams.checked: grep -i "can't pay life|CantPayLife|cannot pay life" in game and cards/effects -> only comments about a player who cannot lose life (effect_api.go:602, corpses_of_the_lost.go, sylvan_library.go, teferis_reproach.go). game/restrictions.go has no life-payment rule.

seams.title: Add 'mana abilities of this land cost an additional 1 life'
seams.clause: Mana abilities of this land cost an additional 1 life to activate.
seams.why: Thran Portal is the chosen basic land type in addition, so its mana ability is the intrinsic one of that type (CR 305.6, game/mana_ability_text.go), not a printed ability a card file can price with PayLife. Needs a cost increase in life on every mana ability of one permanent, including intrinsic and granted ones. CostModifier (game/cost_modifier.go) has Activations but its Unit is a mana cost; the only life surcharge is TargetTax.Life (target_tax.go), for spells. Auto-tap and the bot must know the land costs life. The other three lines have precedents: fastlands.go / conditional_enters_tapped.go ('two or fewer other lands') and land_types.go ChooseBasicLandTypeAsEnters, attachments.go SetsChosenBasicLandType (multiversal_passage.go).
seams.checked: grep 'Mana abilities of this land cost' -> 0; 'cost an additional|costs an additional .* life' -> spec.go, target_tax.go, terror_of_the_peaks.go (spells that target, not activations); grep -i 'LifeIncrease|AdditionalLife|ExtraLife' in game -> none.

seams.title: Report the life paid on an ability's activation event
seams.clause: Whenever you activate an ability that isn't a mana ability, if life was paid to activate it, you may pay that much life again. If you do, copy that ability.
seams.why: PaidCost.LifePaid is computed at activation (game/activated.go:2343-2397, including Phyrexian symbols) and survives on an ability copy (ability_copy.go:297), but the Event struct has no life-paid field, so a trigger on EventActivateAbility cannot ask 'was life paid, and how much'. Small: put the amount on the event (or expose the stack item's PaidCost to the trigger), then build the trigger from the ability-copy precedents (rowan_kenrith.go, the_enigma_jewel.go, lithoform_engine.go).
seams.checked: grep 'if life was paid|pay that much life again' -> only vraska_betrayals_sting.go (compleated). grep -i 'LifePaid|PaidLife' in game -> paid_cost/activated.go/ability_copy.go only; the Event struct (game/events.go) has no such field. No WheneverYouActivate helper reads a paid cost (triggers_common.go:818 is exhaust only).

seams.title: Remember that an opponent's creature or planeswalker was dealt excess damage this turn
seams.clause: At the beginning of your end step, if a creature or planeswalker an opponent controlled was dealt excess damage this turn, create a 4/4 red Dragon creature token with flying.
seams.why: Excess damage is rebuilt per event inside a trigger (cards/effects/excess_damage.go, noncombat and creatures only); nothing keeps it for the turn. Needs a turn tally (game/turn_tally.go) set when damage, combat or not, exceeds lethal on a creature or the loyalty of a planeswalker an opponent of the reader controlled, per controller, and a condition helper. The rest (ward {2}, other Dragons have ward {2}, Dragon token) is ordinary. The 4/4 red Dragon with flying is also made by Rohgahh (batch 18); reuse the tokens_table.go row.
seams.checked: grep 'excess damage this turn|dealt excess damage' -> only fall_of_cair_andros.go (a per-event trigger). grep -i ExcessDamage in game -> none; grep -i excess game/turn_*.go -> none.

seams.title: Add 'it can't phase in for as long as you control this'
seams.clause: Another target nonland permanent phases out. It can't phase in for as long as you control this Saga.
seams.why: The only phase-in lock is the world rule PermanentsCantPhaseIn (game/restrictions.go:140, read in game/phasing.go:288), which stops every permanent. Needs a lock on one phased-out object tied to a source and its controller, ending when the Saga leaves or changes controller (so the permanent phases in at its controller's next untap step after the Saga is sacrificed), and saved in a snapshot (additive). Chapter III is ordinary but declares Sweep: destroy all creatures, each controller creates a 2/2 black Phyrexian token per creature destroyed (new token row). Read ahead exists.
seams.checked: grep "can't phase in" in cards/effects -> the_city_on_the_edge_of_forever.go, trek_b23_helpers.go (world rule only). grep CantPhaseIn in game -> phasing.go, restrictions.go, the world rule only. grep 'It can.t phase in for as long as' -> 0.

seams.title: Promote one shared domain count (helper, not an engine gap)
seams.clause: Domain — ... for each basic land type among lands you control. / This ability costs {1} less to activate for each basic land type among lands you control.
seams.why: Not missing engine work: the count is written twice as private helpers, domainCountYouControl (leyline_binding.go:38, takes a CostQuery) and rfCreatureBBasicLandTypesAmong (reality_fracture_fra_creature_b_helpers.go:134). 21 cards of this set need it in three shapes: a spell or activation cost reduction, a characteristic-defining power/toughness, and a count read at resolution. It is listed as a seam item only so ONE worker exports one helper (an Amount for effects.Do, a CostQuery reader, a P/T static with a Label) before batches 10, 11 and 14 use it, instead of three batches each writing their own. Move the two existing callers onto it. These seven cards cover each shape. Llanowar Greenwidow's granted 'If this permanent would leave the battlefield, exile it instead' has 6 precedents (grep 'would leave the battlefield, exile it instead').
